question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget close this issue as a `sessions.list`-backed compact builtin, or should it wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` Gateway contract before being accepted?
rationale: The UI need is clear, but automation cannot choose the durable session-activity source of truth or the sequencing relative to the open Gateway activity-contract work.

options.title: Accept staged builtin
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate solution, with clear limits around the coarse `sessions.list` data it can show today.

options.title: Wait for activity API
options.body: Keep this issue open until the richer per-session activity contract lands, then implement the widget against that accepted API.

options.title: Fold into roadmap only
options.body: Move sequencing to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 after preserving this issue's specific agent-status requirements there.

recommendation.title: Accept staged builtin
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate solution, with clear limits around the coarse `sessions.list` data it can show today.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses Control UI plugin-tab product direction and current session-status presentation surfaces.
